**5103 Stress ekkocardiogra** is a specific medical procedure code registered in the [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] (the Danish National Health Service Register) [^src1]. It is used to identify and track stress echocardiography examinations performed on patients. 

Within the context of the Danish healthcare system's clinical quality databases—specifically the Database for Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark (AFDK) managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP)—this code plays a vital role in clinical quality measurement [^src1]. It allows health authorities to systematically monitor and evaluate the diagnostic workup of atrial fibrillation patients, ensuring that evidence-based clinical standards are met and compared across different regions. 

The broader diagnostic procedure of [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] (echocardiography) is tracked using a variety of specific codes depending on the exact type of examination performed [^src2]. Alongside "5103 Stress ekkocardiogra", the Sygesikringsregisteret includes several other echocardiography codes to capture the full spectrum of cardiac imaging. These include [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]], [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]], [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] [^src1]. By maintaining this detailed coding taxonomy, the national registries support standardized data collection and robust quality comparisons for cardiovascular disease management.
